stories.title: Contactless pay as you go to launch on Wrexham to Bidston line from 18 May
stories.summary: Contactless pay as you go rail travel arrives on the Wrexham to Bidston line on Monday 18 May, with Shotton, Hawarden, Hawarden Bridge, Buckley and Penyffordd among the 15 stations included. stories.title: Castle Green returns with revised 276-home plan for Ewloe site after refusal
stories.summary: Castle Green Homes has lodged a fresh planning application for the construction of 276 homes at a site in Ewloe. stories.title: Plaid Cymru leader Rhun ap Iorwerth is Wales’ new First Minister, after securing the backing of Senedd Members
stories.summary: Plaid Cymru leader Rhun ap Iorwerth is Wales’ new First Minister, after securing the backing of Senedd Members in the first Plenary session following the election on May 7. stories.title: Royal composer urges talented young Flintshire musicians to bid for £2,000 prize
stories.summary: Young musicians from Flintshire are being urged to bid for a £2,000 prize at a top festival. Royal composer Paul Mealor is backing the prestigious Pendine Young Musician of Wales competition and telling talented youngsters not to miss out on a “glorious opportunity”. stories.title: New book tells story of children cared for at Chester’s Foundling Hospital branch
stories.summary: A new book on the hundreds of abandoned children cared for at the Chester branch of the Foundling Hospital has been published by the University of Chester Press.
